text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first day of summer training camp. 
When I head out 
to the beach with Phalaenopsis, all fired 
up—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All riiight! Let's do this, 
all for the Kikuka Shoooo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, gotta hand it to that youthful 
energy. 
The Kikuka Sho is still ages away, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Then again, never hurts to prep early. 
Guess I'd better ease into it too~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather not let the next one slip away, 
after all. Heh.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
choice_data_list: Your peers are really giving it their all!

Your peers are working hard too, aren't 
they!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown route, contested 
by the likes 
of Special Week and Seiun Sky, was drawing 
massive 
excitement thanks to their stellar 
performances.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason: this year's contenders were 
evenly matched. 
Each horsegirl possessed star power, 
making every single 
race an exhilarating, unpredictable 
contest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The victor of the Satsuki Sho was Seiun 
Sky. 
Conserving her stamina at the bend, she 
accelerated furiously 
down the final stretch, holding off—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's relentless charge. A true 
trickster 
in every sense—a flawless victory born of 
brilliant strategy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the Japanese Derby, as if to avenge her 
defeat 
at the Satsuki Sho—Special Week unleashed 
an explosive 
burst of late speed on the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When the dust settled, she had won by a 
decisive five lengths. 
The stands erupted once more at such an 
overwhelming triumph.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, King Halo, drawing immense 
attention due to her 
mother's pedigree, set her sights on the 
next race with indomitable grit. 
The Classic Triple Crown route right now 
was—
choice_data_list: It's just so thrilling to watch, isn't it!

It really gets your heart racing to watch, 
doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, quite so... 
They are all heroes worthy of enchanting 
the spectators. 
And I, truth be told...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
O layered clouds that veil the sea of 
heaven, 
how majestic are the surging waves that 
rise.
choice_data_list: Oh. Did that poem use "mitate"?
Oho. Did that poem make use of "mitate"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Mitate" is a technique in waka—much like 
likening falling 
blossoms to snow, it is a device where 
something before one's eyes 
is expressed by comparing it to something 
else.
choice_data_list:
Just now, you were comparing the clouds to 
waves... right? Probably.

Just now, you were comparing the clouds to 
waves... right? Probably.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? You recognized it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I studied that much, at least.
Yep, I studied that much, at least.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she recited waka from time to time, 
I had been reading 
a beginner's guide to understand what they 
meant.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Is that so? 
Waka is a splendid art. Even the subtlest, 
most elusive 
feelings within oneself can be shaped into 
a single verse.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And in doing so, I give clarity to my 
heart— 
confirming the joy I feel in celebrating 
their triumphs.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet it does not end with merely offering 
applause.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I must prove through my own running that 
the passion 
of the Triple Tiara burns every bit as 
fierce.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...You have witnessed it as well, have you 
not? 
The flourishing rise of our club.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I saw it.
Yeah, I saw.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Oaks. What lay beyond her 
triumph— 
I saw the results. I saw the growth of our 
Club.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With each display of her strength, step by 
step, 
she drew closer to her cherished 
"beautiful garden."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The future she longed for was now in 
sight.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: All that was left was to make it happen.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, you're right!
...Yeah, that's true!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by her zeal—and above all, 
buoyed by the Club's prosperity... I could 
feel 
a fire igniting in my own heart as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she produced results, it would directly 
lead to her dream. 
In that case, as her Trainer, I needed to—
choice_data_list:
(I have to give this summer everything 
I've got.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. 
Are you prepared?
choice_data_list:
I've planned out our training for the 
Shuka Sho.

I put together some training specifically 
for the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You have my gratitude. 
Let us begin, then.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... Whew. 
This is quite... demanding.
choice_data_list:
Well, it is an upgraded version of 
Hayahide's training.

It is an intensified version of Hayahide's 
training, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
High-intensity interval training. 
Having conquered that, what she faced now 
was—

text_block_list.name: Timer
text_block_list.text: (Beep, beep, beep, beep, ping!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A shuttle run designed to push the body to 
its absolute limits. 
A drill where she sprinted back and forth 
at full speed 
until she could no longer beat the timer's 
chime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Incidentally, the intervals between tones 
had been adjusted— 
if she failed to match or beat the time of 
her very first 
all-out sprint, she was out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In short, Phalaenopsis was now required to 
match 
or exceed her initial sprint time on every 
single run.
choice_data_list: (This regimen is spartan to a fault...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, the Phalaenopsis of today should be 
capable of it. 
For having honed her mental fortitude, 
she had also built up stamina through the 
Oaks.
choice_data_list:
(As her Trainer, this is where I must push 
her.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the Club. For Phalaenopsis. 
I did not hesitate in making this call.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho, the final crown of the 
Triple Tiara— 
we would seize it at all costs. She and I 
surely 
shared that conviction. Which was why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I would push her. 
To bring her to perfection this very 
summer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...
choice_data_list: That's enough for today. Let's cool down.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes... Let us.
choice_data_list:
...If it ever gets too tough, tell me 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Reckless bravado is not my aim. 
That being said—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: This is well. Continue as you are.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(With the Shuka Sho ahead, my Trainer 
burns 
with fighting spirit... This will be a 
fierce summer.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Heh. Splendid resolve. 
Demand whatever you will. Stoke my flames.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I shall hone this body to its absolute 
limits.
